threads.title: CoreWeave Debt Crisis: Credit Contagion to ORCL, DELL, HPE and AI Infrastructure Names
threads.why: CoreWeave's CDS >1,000 bps and bonds at 77 cents drove a sector-wide AI-infrastructure selloff, but the cross-ticker causal links — especially ORCL (-10% Wednesday), DELL/HPE (-7%), and CRWV's own +4.59% close after being down 8% intraday — need a single sourced narrative tying credit stress to equity moves.
